description: It reads whether live streaming is connected on the site: the 100ms connection with its app credentials or manual token and whether a room can be created, the Daily.co connection with key and domain, and for one webinar its own room state and the video source its room uses. Take it when a host asks whether their live room is connected or why the room shows no video. "The room is open and I see nothing." Both providers are read in one answer. It needs the webinar id for the room state, otherwise it reads the whole install. It changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: live streaming, room connected, no video, stream key

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, to read that campaign's own room state.
